slides.title: 1 in 2 SOC Analysts Burns Out in Year 1
slides.subtitle: Here's what nobody says before you apply

bullets: Alert fatigue hits faster than most expect
Most Tier 1 roles have no real growth path
The ones who thrive treat SOC as a stepping stone
Start planning your next move from day one

caption: SOC is a great entry point - but the burnout is real and most people don't talk about it. Go in with a plan. #cybersecurity #soc #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs #infosec
